readout_conventions.cutoff: always shown in kHz, e.g. 12.00 kHz
readout_conventions.resonance: 0.707 (neutral) to 10.0, shown as a percentage of the travel

slots.root_note_explanation: MIDI 60. C3 in JUCE's octave numbering, C5 on FL Studio's piano roll. A sample plays at its recorded pitch when a note of 60 arrives and Tune is at 50 %.
slots.voice_stealing: the oldest sounding voice is reused when all sixteen are busy
slots.keyboard_routing: the keyboard plays the slot marked KEYS (state property play_slot); clicking a slot's waveform auditions that slot at the root note
slots.missing_file_behaviour: the slot keeps the file name it was saved with, shows it in red and stays silent; nothing crashes

slot_parameters.what_it_does: Pitches the whole slot. 0 % is two octaves down, 50 % is the file at the pitch it was recorded at, 100 % is two octaves up.
slot_parameters.what_you_hear: Lower is a fatter, slower sound; higher is thinner and faster. It moves the note the sample sits at, so the keyboard tracks from there.

slot_parameters.what_it_does: How loud this slot is, before the shared filter and the master level.
slot_parameters.what_you_hear: The slot sitting under or over the others. It changes the balance, not the tone.

slot_parameters.what_it_does: Fade-in time, 1 ms at 0 % to about 2 s at 100 %.
slot_parameters.what_you_hear: A hard edge at the bottom of the knob, a soft swell at the top. The default is short enough to be inaudible but long enough to stop a click.

slot_parameters.what_it_does: Fade-out time after a note-off on a looped slot, 5 ms at 0 % to about 3 s at 100 %.
slot_parameters.what_you_hear: A loop that stops dead, or one that fades away like a sustaining instrument. One-shots ignore it: they always play to the end.

slot_parameters.what_it_does: Where playback begins, as a percentage of the file.
slot_parameters.what_you_hear: Dead air at the head of a sample disappears, so the hit lands on the beat instead of after it.

slot_parameters.what_it_does: Where playback ends, as a percentage of the file. In Loop mode this is also the point it wraps back to Start.
slot_parameters.what_you_hear: The tail of a sample is cut off, which is the other half of making a loop that does not trail under the next bar.

mode_parameters.what_it_does: One-Shot plays from Start to End and stops, whatever the note does. Loop repeats between Start and End for as long as the note is held.
mode_parameters.what_you_hear: A drum hit or a vocal stab that always finishes, or a sustained sound you can hold.

global_parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
global_parameters.what_it_does: Sets where the shared low-pass filter starts rolling off all eight slots.
global_parameters.what_you_hear: Down goes dark and muffled, up opens to full brightness.

global_parameters.name: Filter Resonance
global_parameters.what_it_does: How much the filter emphasises the frequencies right at the cutoff. 0.707 is neutral.
global_parameters.what_you_hear: A whistle appears at the cutoff and the sound takes on a squelchy character.

global_parameters.name: Master Level
global_parameters.what_it_does: The final volume of the whole plugin, after the filter.
global_parameters.what_you_hear: Louder or quieter, nothing else changes.

non_automatable_state.slot_paths: slot1_path ... slot8_path, absolute paths in the plugin state tree
non_automatable_state.slot_names: slot1_name ... slot8_name, the file name shown on the panel

signal_chain.name: Sixteen sample voices
signal_chain.api: 4-point interpolated playback at 2^((note - 60 + tune) / 12), mono or stereo source

signal_chain.name: Shared low-pass filter
signal_chain.marker: STAGE 2 — Shared low-pass filter (juce::dsp), one per output channel

signal_chain.name: Master level
signal_chain.marker: STAGE 3 — Master level, then a plain clamp
signal_chain.api: linear ramp across the block + applyGainRamp + safety clamp
